description:
*Objective:* Verify that the stock check counts copies already in the cart: a second add that pushes the total above stock is rejected.

*Type:* negative  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* A regular user account is available
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* Book "Ariel" has stock S0 >= 3; read S0 at run time

*Test data:*
* Book: Ariel
* First add: S0 - 1
* Second add: 2 (cart total would be S0 + 1)

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; the cart badge in the navigation is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "Ariel" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "Ariel" is listed
# Open the detail page of "Ariel"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "Ariel"
# Read the stock number next to Stock and remember it as S0  
   *Expected:* A stock number is shown
# Set Quantity to S0 - 1 and click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* Cart badge shows S0 - 1
# Set Quantity to 2 and click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* A visible error states there is not enough stock; cart badge still shows S0 - 1
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* One line "Ariel" with quantity S0 - 1

*Postconditions:*
* Cart holds "Ariel" with quantity S0 - 1, unchanged by the rejected add

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
* Related bug: REF-29
title: Reject second add when cart plus new quantity exceeds stock
